title: Page 272
transc:
Hd Qrs Army of James Dec 4
1250 PM
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Harriet for Tappan Carney famish zodiac Tell Pandora Saunders make
a wick Tobey sent me tomorrows boat of property round
him by any officers Pekin captured at the time or
take from Stephen Barton of Bartons ville abacus zebra say
toothing about this wrangle zodiac if pandora sanders is not
able to make the wick himself pekin get the facts
and make the wick yourself pedlar also send me all
the books and papers taken from Barton zodiac make and
send these wicks without attracting any observation walrus Knox funny
R OBrien
